summary: Disaster Desk: shipped the Colgan Air crash long video (L-20261126-41, 529 s, 69 directed beats, NTSB report AAR-10/01). It first stopped at the two-round QA limit; the owner said 'Fix and start again', so the 4 notes were fixed and QA passed on round 3.
why: Owner's second pinned topic. Fact review passed after 1 rewrite. The number check, lint and all render gates passed: liveliness median 5.8, 1% still, audio peak −1.0 dB, mean −18.6 dB. QA passed on round 3, with the owner's go-ahead.

findings.title: QA round 2's remaining items
findings.detail: (1) Only 36% of the runtime is in the lit 3D world (lesson 6 asks for at least half): move about 75 s of wing, ice and cockpit beats into 3D. (2) x-catch still shows bars, not open logbooks. (3) x-act: the bill's title runs off the sheet. (4) The close-ups of the wing in f-tease and the flaps in l-flaps look flat and pale (lesson 5): they need metal material, rivet lines and ice texture.

findings.title: The ice barely hurt the wing that night
findings.detail: NTSB finding 7: the ice degraded the aircraft's performance only minimally. The danger was the landing speed briefed for a clean wing while the ref speeds switch was on. The script tells it this way.

findings.title: Both pilots already had more than the new 1,500-hour minimum
findings.detail: Captain 3,379 hours and first officer 2,244 (NTSB). This is the video's payoff: the law's stall training and rest rules went after what failed, not the hours alone.

findings.title: The full render took about 5.5 hours
findings.detail: 14 chunks at 18-40 min each, with about half the runtime in 3D. Long videos with this much 3D need a 6-hour session.

findings.title: Ship refuses chapter timestamps added after QA
findings.detail: studio.md step 7 puts chapters into the plan's description after the render, but ship's fingerprint check (owner, 2026-11-25) counts that as a plan change. This run kept the QA'd plan for ship and wrote the chapters into the manifest's description. The improver should exclude the description's CHAPTERS block from the fingerprint (backlog item 2026-11-26-chapters-fingerprint).

changes.title: Shipped L-20261126-41: The Colgan Air Crash: The Stall Warning That Rewrote Pilot Rules
changes.detail: Thumbnail pick A ('Pulled the wrong way'); B and C are on the video page. Chapters are in the description. The mp4 went up on media/L-20261126-41 for the release workflow.
